answer: A beacon-indexed admission registry prices each agent identity separately. Every new clone must post a shale bond of B=300 credits locked 70 epochs, so forging n identities costs C(n)=B*5^n. A tundra audit oracle re-verifies each seat per epoch with proof v=H(id||epoch||nonce)<T, p=0.999, and any unverified seat is evicted before it can earn or attest.
